== Summary ==
Identified: [[Tamás Papp]] (blue tee, denim shorts) and [[Chris Menzel]] (black penguin shirt; same clothing as [[:File:2023 Naboo Regionals 5.jpg]]). The man in the sage Jack & Jones Denimwear shirt (same person as the pink shirt in [[:File:2023 Naboo Regionals 2.jpg]]) is holding a card with the Belgian flag and the name Jeroen; that is not treated as a self-identification.

Players at the venue at the 2023 Naboo Regionals ("Foil Fest") weekend in Liverpool, UK, June 2023, hosted by Team Wales.

* '''Event:''' [[2023 Regional Championships]]
* '''Date:''' June 2023
* '''Date posted:''' 2023-05-31
* '''Identification:''' [[Tamás Papp]] (blue tee, denim shorts) and [[Chris Menzel]] (black penguin shirt; same clothing as [[:File:2023 Naboo Regionals 5.jpg]]). The man in the sage Jack & Jones Denimwear shirt (same person as the pink shirt in [[:File:2023 Naboo Regionals 2.jpg]]) is holding a card with the Belgian flag and the name Jeroen; that is not treated as a self-identification.
